title: Tool Framework + File Tools (read/write/edit) + Tier Classifier
description:
Implement tool framework and file tools from docs/plans/06-built-in-tools.md.

Sections: §3.1 (ToolBackend, ToolRequest, ToolResponse, ToolProgress), §3.2 (Factories), §3.3 (Tool Catalog - file tools), §4.1-§4.4 (read_file, write_file, edit_file), §5.1 (LocalBackend), §5.3 (Tier Classifier)

Key deliverables:
- ToolBackend interface with ExecuteTool(ctx, req, onProgress) signature
- ToolRequest, ToolResponse, ToolProgress types
- LocalBackend: direct in-process execution for Tier 1 tools
- Tier classifier function (shared across tools/backends)
- NewLocalTools factory returning []agent.AgentTool
- read_file: offset/limit, max-size guards
- write_file: atomic write with optional dir creation
- edit_file: exact string replacement, structured mismatch diagnostics
- Unit tests for all of the above

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
See Implementation Guide §1.5 (AgentTool), §1.6 (ToolBackend), §4.6 (ToolBackend signature drift pitfall), §5 (Seam: agent.AgentTool ↔ tools factories)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/06-built-in-tools.md §3-§5
- Test harness: docs/plans/06-built-in-tools-test-harness.md
- Depends on: T1 (Agent Core - needs AgentTool type)
